manuscript_role: The do-no-harm spatial-residual redesign under the shipped recipe (gamma -> 0).

selection.rule: Best-by-validation on the selection metric sel = 0.5 * (video-AUC at c23 + video-AUC at c40), computed on the official FF++ validation split after every epoch; the checkpoint of the epoch with the highest sel is kept. CAFRL arms evaluate the EMA weights, baseline and control arms the raw weights (they train no EMA). No test-split quantity enters selection.
selection.tie_break: Strict improvement (>) — on an exact tie the earlier epoch is kept.
